newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks seen falling on poor sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks seen falling on poor sentiment.

text.p: Thai stocks were expected to continue declining on Friday on poor market sentiment resulting from further declines in Wall Street and regional markets today, brokers said. The SET index fell 13.61 points to 872.25 on thin 2.4 billion baht turnover on Thursday. The SET-50 index dipped 1.18 points to 66.08.

"The SET index is expected to move in negative zone today because of falls on the Wall Street overnight and Asian markets early today. No positive factor is seen so far." said a broker at a foreign brokerage house. -- Suthep Chawla (662) 652-0642
